subject: adding the commented out tests (#827)
reason: The change only edits valkey-search's own Python integration test suite (testing/integration/stability_test.py): it re-enables three previously commented-out stability test cases (text/tag/numeric with backfill, coordinator and replica) and turns on background ftcreate/ftdropindex/flushdb intervals and failover testing in the existing cases. No module source, build, or configuration file changes; the compiled module at the change commit is byte-for-byte functionally identical to the parent's.
